name: Gaussian Splat Rasterization (Vertex Shader)
definition: A vertex shader that transforms 3D Gaussians into 2D ellipses on screen, handling data unpacking, covariance transformation, frustum culling, and position computation for instanced rendering.
summary: Gaussian Splat Rasterization (Vertex Shader) transforms 3D Gaussian primitives into 2D ellipses within the vertex shader, differing from fragment-based approaches by handling all geometric projection and ellipse computation on the CPU-side vertex stage.
